tex_content.html: Let $U\subset \R ^n$ be bounded with smooth boundary, let $f\in L^2(U)$, and consider \[ \begin{cases} -\Div \, \mathbf a(Du)=f & \text{in }U,\\ u=0 & \text{on }\partial U, \end{cases} \tag {1} \] where $\mathbf a:\R ^n\to \R ^n$ is smooth.
